labels.随机发放签到奖励金额并研究参与和留存。形成奖励序列后的条件比较存在行为选择，不自: Reward amounts are randomly assigned to study participation and retention. Conditional comparisons after reward-sequence formation involve behavioral selection and do not automatically equal the randomized average effect of the sequence.
More than 28,000 people enrolled, and 15,816 met the final analysis criteria. The increasing sequence had the lowest formation rate (3.5%; flat 5.7%, decreasing 5.2%, volatile 5.0%). On Day 4, retention under flat and increasing sequences exceeded that under decreasing and volatile sequences; the difference between flat and increasing sequences was not significant. Retention on Day 5 fell significantly after an increasing trend was interrupted. The authors therefore recommend a flat reward sequence.

On odd-numbered experiment days, users were randomly assigned 8, 58, or 108 points; on even-numbered days, everyone received 58 points. The analyses examine the probability of forming flat, increasing, decreasing, and volatile sequences; retention on Day 4 after sequence formation; and retention on Day 5 after an interrupted trend.

The analysis sample is limited to users who checked in on the first odd-numbered day and began checking in early enough. labels.比较AI漫画披露框架对付费和阅读行为的影响，处理分派及运营控制组的可比性仍需核查: Compares how AI-comic disclosure framing affects payment and reading behavior; comparability between treatment assignment and the operational control group still requires checking.
labels.已报告回归。简单披露组相对无披露在转化、支付、观看集数和总时长更低；规范框架五项: Regression results are reported. Relative to no disclosure, the simple-disclosure group has lower conversion, payment, episode views, and total viewing time. None of the five measures in the normative-framing condition differs significantly from the no-disclosure condition. In the technical-framing condition, conversion and payment do not differ significantly, but episode views and total viewing time remain significantly lower. The effort-framing condition is closer to simple disclosure. A nonsignificant difference does not establish strict equivalence.
labels.付费网络漫画公司的现场信息披露实验。单一漫画、广告和活动设置一致；4个披露处理组: A field information-disclosure experiment at a paid online-comics company. The same comic, advertisement, and campaign settings were used; each of the four disclosure treatment groups had 200 viewers. A further 199 viewers who did not see disclosure information were sampled from routine operations as the control group.
labels.作者称现场实验，但所给页段没有明确说明四个处理组如何随机分配，也没有说明日常运营: The authors call this a field experiment, but the supplied page excerpts do not clearly explain how participants were randomized across the four treatment groups or how the operational control sample was matched to the treatment groups. Randomization/comparability for within-treatment and treatment-versus-control comparisons is therefore not fully specified.
labels.转化率用Logit，支付金额/观看集数/总时长/单集平均时长用OLS；报告处理条: Conversion is estimated with Logit; payment amount, episodes viewed, total viewing time, and average viewing time per episode are estimated with OLS. Regressions use indicators for treatment conditions.
labels.观众—漫画层面的购买转化、支付金额、观看集数、总观看时长、单集平均观看时长；观众: At the viewer–comic level: purchase conversion, amount paid, episodes viewed, total viewing time, and average viewing time per episode. At the viewer–episode level: reading status and demographics.
labels.现场实验的组间回归；无形式化博弈模型。: Between-group regression in a field experiment; no formal game-theoretic model.
labels.作者明确称为理论基础；比较等价框架与强调框架，以改变观众注意到的AI属性: Explicitly identified as a theoretical foundation; compares equivalence framing with emphasis framing to change which AI attributes viewers notice.
labels.被研究现象与动机，不作为独立的正式理论框架: The phenomenon and motivation under study; not treated as an independent formal theoretical framework.
labels.规范框架（AI模型被用户接受）: Normative framework (acceptance of AI models by users).
labels.努力框架（AI模型训练投入）: Effort framework (investment in training the AI model).
labels.估计：DML-IV（作者主张）: Estimation: DML-IV (as claimed by the authors).
labels.研究健康文章中的meme与阅读完成率，采用DML-IV并用OCR、CLIP及LL: The study examines memes in health articles and reading completion, using DML-IV and OCR, CLIP, and LLMs for measurement; instrument diagnostics do not establish the exclusion restriction.
labels.DML与DML-IV均报告负线性项、正二次项，作者称为U形；DML-IV线性系数: Both DML and DML-IV report a negative linear term and a positive quadratic term, which the authors characterize as U-shaped; in DML-IV, the linear coefficient is −.6241 and the squared-term coefficient is .7969, with a turning point at about 1.5 memes. Relevance attenuates the U shape. The interaction between humor and meme count is not significant, but in a subsample with at least one meme, humor has a coefficient of .1690 for completion rate (p<.1). The U shape is more pronounced for long articles and infectious-disease content.
labels.微信官方健康传播账号2021-01至2023-12全部原创文章的观测数据；N=2: Observational data cover all original articles posted from 2021-01 through 2023-12 by an official WeChat health-communication account (N=2,876 articles; more than 18 million followers). The authors use DML-IV to study meme count and reading completion, and examine content relevance/humor and heterogeneity by article length/topic.
labels.作者主张DML-IV因果识别。工具变量为账号前一日发布meme总量和前一日新浪微: The authors claim causal identification using DML-IV. The instruments are the account's total meme posts on the preceding day and the number of Sina Weibo hot-search topics on the preceding day. They report KP LM χ²(2)=123.10, p<.001, Wald F=69.10, and Hansen J p=.586. The authors argue for the exclusion restriction; the coding does not treat these diagnostics as independent proof of that restriction.
labels.Double/Debiased Machine Learning with in: Double/debiased machine learning with instruments; Elastic Net nuisance functions and cross-fitting; models for log(meme count) and its squared term; heterogeneity examined through subsamples, interactions, and group comparisons.
labels.DV完成率=开启阅读者中读完文章的比例；meme检测四阶段流程（OCR、CLIP: DV completion rate = the proportion of readers who opened an article and finished reading it; four-stage meme detection (OCR, CLIP template matching, hard-negative filtering, and domain-term filtering), with recall of 82.1% on manual checks of 300 randomly sampled images; relevance measured by Sentence-BERT semantic similarity; humor rated by Qwen-VL-plus on a 0–10 scale; text controls include 25 LIWC dimensions.
labels.非线性因果回归/DML-IV；主要剂量变量为log_meme_count及平方项: Nonlinear causal regression/DML-IV; the main dose variable is log_meme_count and its squared term.
labels.解释低meme数量可能干扰阅读、主题相关meme可降低外在负荷: Explains that too few memes may disrupt reading, while topic-relevant memes may reduce extraneous cognitive load.
labels.与认知负荷互补，用于解释高meme整合和幽默带来的沉浸/持续阅读: Complements cognitive load to explain immersion and continued reading associated with high meme integration and humor.
labels.文章内meme数量的对数及其平方；扩展变量为meme-context相关性和幽默: Log and squared terms for the number of memes in an article; extended variables are meme–context relevance and humor.
labels.LIWC特征、图片数、字数、月份、假日、周末、发布时段: LIWC features, number of images, word count, month, holidays, weekends, and posting time.
labels.以双兴趣路径和情境门控预测新闻排序，在MIND上比较基线及消融；门控是动机代理，: Predicts news rankings using dual-interest pathways and contextual gating, with baseline and ablation comparisons on MIND; the gate is a motivational proxy, not a direct psychological measure.
labels.视觉核对结果表：完整模型NDCG@5=.3867、HR@5=.5600、NDCG: Visual cross-check results: the full model achieves NDCG@5=.3867, HR@5=.5600, NDCG@10=.4557, and HR@10=.7735; its NDCG@5 is 1.5999% higher than TiSASRec. Removing the instrumental-interest path produces the largest decline (NDCG@5 −17.6387%); removing the gate yields −8.7653%. These are ranking metrics, not causal effects.
labels.非因果预测/排序模型设计；在MIND新闻消费数据上与TiSASRec、LSTUR: A noncausal predictive/ranking-model design; compared with baselines such as TiSASRec, LSTUR, and CAUM on MIND news-consumption data, with ablations of the two pathways and temporal gate.
labels.无因果识别；实验目标是排序预测及行为模式解释。: No causal identification; experiments aim to rank predictions and explain behavioral patterns.
labels.共享内容语义表示上的双兴趣路径：情境提示下的仪式化兴趣路径、注意用户近期交互与时: Two interest pathways share a semantic representation of content: a ritualistic-interest path conditioned on contextual prompts, and an instrumental-interest path that attends to recent user interactions and time decay. A temporal-context gate weights the two paths to form an interest representation. The model is evaluated using NDCG@5/10 and HR@5/10, with ablation analyses.
labels.MIND用户新闻点击、内容文本和时间戳；先保留至少3次历史点击的用户，情境以日内: MIND users’ news clicks, content text, and timestamps. The analysis first retains users with at least three historical clicks; context is represented by discrete indicators such as time of day and day of week. Latent motives are not observed directly; gating values are operational signals inferred from behavioral and contextual inputs.
labels.Context-Aware Gated Dual-Interest Model；: Context-Aware Gated Dual-Interest Model; page 21 gives the two-path softmax representation, gate g_t, and combined interest representation.
labels.作者明确作为行为区分和模型构念依据；平台记录不能直接观测真实动机: Explicitly used as a basis for distinguishing behavior and defining model constructs; platform records cannot directly observe actual motives.
labels.用户历史点击/内容语义、时间情境 → 用户对候选新闻的兴趣排序；非因果自变量/因: User history clicks/content semantics and temporal context → user interest ranking of candidate news; noncausal predictors/outcome.
labels.基于前景理论和平台分阶段推出，采用DID、PSM和IV研究算法配送平台进入对交通: Based on prospect theory and a platform’s staggered rollout, uses DID, PSM, and IV to study the effect of algorithmic delivery-platform entry on traffic accidents.
labels.完成准自然实验并报告结果: The quasi-natural experiment is complete and results are reported.

labels.城市交通事故；算法摩擦、数字不耐烦和骑手脆弱性: Urban traffic accidents; algorithmic friction, digital impatience, and rider vulnerability.

labels.建设性适应行为、努力无效感、例外处理支持；测量unknown: Constructive adaptive behavior, perceived futility of effort, and exception-handling support; measures: unknown.

labels.中国iOS应用纵向面板准自然实验: Quasi-natural experiment using a longitudinal panel of Chinese iOS apps.
labels.准自然实验（监管专项行动）；估计方法unknown: Quasi-natural experiment (regulatory campaign); estimation method: unknown.

labels.愉悦、唤醒、参与意向、视觉线索、好奇心；中介/调节: Pleasure, arousal, participation intention, visual cues, curiosity; mediation/moderation.

labels.系统回顾AI创造力相关文献，综合算法厌恶及协作策略等发现。: A systematic review of literature on AI creativity, synthesizing findings on algorithm aversion, collaboration strategies, and related topics.

labels.跨AI、认知心理与创意领域文献；综合研究发现: Synthesis of research findings across AI, cognitive psychology, and creativity.
labels.结合控制实验与多智能体Q-learning，研究虚拟主播静态与动态设计特征的协同: Combines controlled experiments and multi-agent Q-learning to study the joint effects of static and dynamic virtual-streamer design features.

labels.控制实验校准参数并用于多智能体强化学习模型: Calibrates parameters with controlled experiments and applies them to a multi-agent reinforcement-learning model.
labels.实验用于参数校准；模型仿真: Experiment for parameter calibration; model simulation.

labels.基于加工流畅性理论，用在线实验研究验证码中的品牌线索对后续资源分配的影响。: Based on processing-fluency theory, uses an online experiment to study how brand cues in CAPTCHAs affect subsequent resource allocation.
labels.实验；随机条件细节unknown: Experiment; details of randomized conditions unknown.
labels.品牌相关验证码线索与品牌资源分配: Brand-related CAPTCHA cues and allocation of brand resources.
labels.三项实验研究AI设计者身份对产品健康与口味感知的影响及功能导向中介。: Three experiments study how the identity of an AI product designer affects perceptions of product healthfulness and taste, and the mediating role of functional orientation.
labels.产品健康感、口味感、功能导向及产品健康相关性: Product healthiness perception, taste perception, functional orientation, and product-health relevance.
labels.以中国隧道掘进机出口澳大利亚案例提出战略信息冗余概念及三类实践。: Uses the case of exporting Chinese tunnel-boring machines to Australia to propose the concept of strategic information redundancy and three types of practice.
labels.完成深入案例分析并归纳实践类型: The in-depth case analysis is complete and practice types are identified.
labels.中国隧道掘进机出口澳洲深入案例研究: In-depth case study of Chinese tunnel-boring-machine exports to Australia.
labels.技术知识、操作培训和合规信息冗余；质性机制: Technical knowledge, operational training, and redundant compliance information; qualitative mechanism.
labels.建立竞争模型研究区块链引发信息泄漏如何影响品牌/非品牌卖家采用及平台合同选择。: Develops a competition model of how blockchain-induced information leakage affects adoption by branded and unbranded sellers and platform contract choices.
labels.品牌/非品牌卖家及平台合同的竞争分析模型: Competitive analytical model of branded/non-branded sellers and platform contracts.
labels.模仿成本、品牌识别、区块链采用与市场绩效: Imitation costs, brand recognition, blockchain adoption, and market performance.
labels.结合三项实验研究精确或模糊数值表达如何与个性化/一般预测匹配以促进AI采纳。: Combines three experiments to study how precise or vague numerical expressions interact with personalized or general forecasts to promote AI adoption.
labels.情境实验（N=329）、互动聊天实验（N=394）及行为实验（N=381）: Uses a scenario experiment (N=329), an interactive-chat experiment (N=394), and a behavioral experiment (N=381).
labels.实验；多种数值表达与预测类型条件: Experiment; conditions vary by numerical expression and forecast type.
labels.采纳意愿、信息不确定性和非典型感: Adoption intention, information uncertainty, and atypicality.
labels.建立博弈模型研究平台如何设定变现门槛以治理异质创作者的原创或人机合作路径。: Develops a game-theoretic model of how platforms set monetization thresholds to govern heterogeneous creators' original versus human–AI collaborative paths.
labels.完成模型分析并报告策略结论: Completes model analysis and reports strategic conclusions.
labels.平台与异质创作者博弈论模型: A game-theoretic model of a platform and heterogeneous creators.
labels.收入激励、AI能力、变现门槛、创作者努力和社会最优: Income incentives, AI capability, monetization thresholds, creator effort, and the social optimum.
labels.基于Maslow需求层次和期望理论提出人形代理动机模型，并在两类投资任务中评估。: Based on Maslow's hierarchy of needs and expectancy theory, proposes a motivational model for humanoid agents and evaluates it in two types of investment tasks.
labels.完成实验并报告跨任务结果: The experiment is complete and cross-task results are reported.
labels.两类金融投资决策任务实验评估: Experimental evaluation on two types of financial-investment decision tasks.
labels.人类相似性、跨任务泛化和任务表现: Human similarity, cross-task generalization, and task performance.
labels.Maslow需求层次与期望理论动机模型: Maslow’s hierarchy of needs and expectancy-theory motivation model.
labels.五年原件齐备；目录/正文对齐与编码状态逐条保留: The five-year source corpus is complete; TOC/body alignment and coding status are retained item by item.
labels.以875位店长的纵向委派过程研究管理者与AI的协作。管理者对AI表现的评价、能力: A longitudinal study of delegation by 875 store managers examines manager–AI collaboration. Managers' evaluations of AI performance, perceptions of its capabilities, and willingness to delegate form feedback loops; delegation intentions may diverge over time.
labels.提出人和AI多主体协调的设计理论。已有规范与预测模型共同作用，预测误差促使主体在: A design theory is proposed for coordination among multiple human and AI agents. Existing norms and predictive models jointly shape action; prediction errors prompt agents to adjust norms in unanticipated situations, while design principles support monitoring and intervention.
labels.将AI公平问题解释为组织、技术与治理选择相互作用形成的持续张力。FAIR设计理论: AI fairness is framed as a persistent tension arising from interactions among organizational, technical, and governance choices. FAIR design theory proposes an adaptive cycle for identifying and addressing tensions, along with system-level and portfolio-level governance mechanisms.
labels.研究医院加入健康信息交换后数据泄露风险的变化，以治理与协调解释跨组织共享可能同时: The study examines changes in data-breach risk after hospitals join a health information exchange. It uses governance and coordination to explain how interorganizational sharing may simultaneously create risks and security practices, and compares settings by IT maturity and security-law context.
labels.使用中国网约车平台数据和限行差异带来的外生冲击识别短期工资弹性，结果与司机以每日: Uses Chinese ride-hailing platform data and an exogenous shock created by driving restrictions to identify short-run wage elasticity. Results are consistent with a mechanism in which drivers decide when to stop based on daily income targets; taxi drivers are also compared.
labels.研究智能音箱采用与数字内容搜索、购买、消费之间的关系。结合家庭面板、遥控器使用和: Studies the relationship between smart-speaker adoption and digital-content search, purchase, and consumption. Household panels, remote-control usage, and survey evidence distinguish increased purchasing from reduced completed consumption, and the study discusses a search-cost mechanism.
labels.以公立学校配置的算法决策案例说明，技术之外的组织回避及制度响应也会遮蔽问题，形成: A case involving algorithmic decision-making in public-school allocation illustrates how organizational avoidance and institutional responses beyond the technology can obscure the problem, creating a social and institutional black box that affects correction and legal remedies.
labels.在AMT与Prolific上开展在线实验，比较监控强度、透明度和信息控制对接受工: Online experiments on AMT and Prolific compare how monitoring intensity, transparency, and information control affect willingness to accept work. Privacy concerns and perceived payment protection form distinct pathways, and transparency and control measures have boundaries in their applicability.
labels.两项嵌套混合方法实验研究预期披露GenAI使用如何改变创作者的协作。创作者担心其: Two nested mixed-method experiments are proposed to study how disclosing GenAI use changes creators' collaboration. Creators may fear that audiences will not recognize their creative agency, reducing participation; thus, disclosure policy may affect the work before audiences see the label.
labels.以两项预注册任务、3750位参与者研究模型升级和提示适应的互补性。固定评价任务与: Two preregistered tasks with 3,750 participants examine the complementarity of model upgrades and prompt adaptation. Adaptation gains differ between fixed evaluation tasks and open-ended creative tasks; automatic prompt rewriting also depends on goal alignment.
labels.通过现场实验及后续实验比较天气情境下收益或损失框架信息对运动目标完成的影响，并考: A field experiment and follow-up experiments compare how gain- versus loss-framed information in weather contexts affects completion of exercise goals, and examine heterogeneity by repeated intervention and low-activity/low-income areas.
labels.以三项实验检验评论和评分等信息线索如何降低用户对不匹配赞助搜索结果的怀疑。区分决: Three experiments test how information cues such as reviews and ratings can reduce users’ suspicion of mismatched sponsored search results. The study distinguishes decision uncertainty, perceived platform malice, and result processing, and analyzes when cues are internalized.
labels.三项实验表明认知资源消耗、积极情绪及其联合作用会削弱隐私顾虑与实际披露行为的关系: Three experiments show that cognitive-resource depletion, positive affect, and their joint effect weaken the relationship between privacy concerns and actual disclosure behavior. The privacy paradox is context-dependent and cannot be read as evidence that individuals do not care about privacy.
labels.使用156个Reddit社区的计量分析研究审核机器人对志愿版主的影响，区分规则执: An econometric analysis of moderation bots across 156 Reddit communities examines effects on volunteer moderators, distinguishes rule enforcement from community cultivation, and discusses scale heterogeneity and volunteer retention.
labels.以平台分城市进入研究当地不同技能层级的就业重分配；城市/职业层面的处理不等于个人: Studies employment reallocation across local skill levels following a platform's entry into cities; city/occupation-level treatment is not an individual contract intervention.
labels.通过专家访谈与劳动者评分发展算法控制抵抗的内容效度，不是合同权利干预的因果效果。: Expert interviews and worker ratings establish content validity for resistance to algorithmic control; this is not a causal effect of contract-rights interventions.
labels.基于司机问卷研究算法程序公平、满意度和组织支持感；需与实际后台权利、客观行为区分: Uses driver surveys to study algorithmic procedural fairness, satisfaction, and perceived organizational support; these should be distinguished from actual back-end rights and objective behavior.
labels.反馈更多，协作质量为何没有更好？: Why does more feedback fail to improve collaboration quality?
labels.分开反馈数量与反馈代表性，检验核验成本造成的选择偏差。: Separates feedback volume from feedback representativeness and tests selection bias caused by verification costs.
labels.自愿反馈是否遗漏困难错误，进而损害下一轮AI协作表现？: Does voluntary feedback omit difficult errors, thereby harming AI collaboration performance in the next round?
labels.任务难度→核验成本→反馈进入样本→更新质量。: Task difficulty → verification cost → feedback entering the sample → update quality.
labels.自愿反馈与等预算随机核验对照；冻结初始输出、任务库与更新算法，使用独立保留任务。: Compares voluntary feedback with random audit under an equal budget; freezes initial outputs, the task pool, and the update algorithm, and evaluates on independent holdout tasks.
labels.若反馈代表性没有变化，或代表性改善而保留任务不改善，原机制不获支持。: The proposed mechanism is unsupported if feedback representativeness does not change, or if representativeness improves but performance on holdout tasks does not.
labels.EXT01委派动态；EXT10提示适应；EXT09披露预期。先检查原会议全文是否: EXT01: delegation dynamics; EXT10: adaptive prompting; EXT09: disclosure expectations. First check whether the conference full texts already contain the same choice mechanism.
labels.需要授权任务与可重复的模型更新；没有平台训练权限时使用受控研究环境。: Requires authorization for the task and repeatable model updates; without platform training access, use a controlled research environment.
labels.解释清楚之后，错误决定能否被纠正？: After an explanation, can an erroneous decision actually be corrected?
labels.区分透明解释与能真正改变误判的申诉渠道。: Distinguishes transparent explanations from appeal channels that can actually correct misjudgments.
labels.解释和可执行申诉分别怎样影响误判修复与后续合规参与？: How do explanations and actionable appeals, separately, affect correction of erroneous judgments and subsequent compliant participation?
labels.可执行纠错→实际恢复与控制感→合规参与。: Actionable correction → actual recovery and perceived control → compliant participation.
labels.解释×可执行申诉的2×2随机实验，固定初始错误并记录真实恢复；与等时长信息控制比: A 2 × 2 randomized experiment on explainability × actionable appeal fixes the initial error and records actual recovery; compares the treatment with a time-matched information control.
labels.若只有满意度提高而错误持续、合规贡献不变，或安慰流程产生同样变化，不支持纠错机制: If only satisfaction improves while errors persist and compliance contributions do not change, or an equal-time reassurance procedure produces the same change, that would not support the correction mechanism.
labels.EXT14 Reddit治理；EXT07制度黑箱；EXT03 FAIR。与三篇全: The three entries overlap with the full texts EXT14 (Reddit governance), EXT07 (institutional black boxes), and EXT03 (FAIR). The innovation-versus-replication positioning should be decided only after comparing the full papers.
labels.受控任务结果不直接代表所有公共算法治理。: Controlled-task results do not directly generalize to all public algorithm-governance contexts.
labels.数据合同写明权利，后台是否真正兑现？: Does a data contract specify rights, and does the backend actually honor them?
labels.把合同披露与可执行数据权利分开，观察接单、质量和规避行为。: Separates contract disclosure from enforceable data rights and observes task acceptance, quality, and avoidance behavior.
labels.披露承诺与实际可执行的数据权利是否通过不同路径影响零工行为？: Do disclosure commitments and enforceable data rights affect gig-worker behavior through different pathways?
labels.可执行权利→实际控制与风险判断→任务选择和努力。: Enforceable rights → actual control and risk judgments → task choice and effort.
labels.在支付、监控强度、任务难度相同条件下操纵披露和后台执行；记录真实权利使用和行为。: Manipulate disclosure and backend execution while holding pay, monitoring intensity, and task difficulty constant; record actual rights use and behavior.
labels.若只有信任自报变化而真实使用与行为不变，不支持可执行权利机制。: If only self-reported trust changes while actual use and behavior do not, the evidence does not support an actionable rights mechanism.
labels.EXT08监控/透明/控制；EXT16控制抵抗量表；EXT17算法程序公平；EX: EXT08: monitoring/transparency/control; EXT16: control-resistance scale; EXT17: algorithmic procedural fairness; EXT05: wage targets and EXT15: labor reallocation boundaries.
labels.EXT08及会议数据合同论文可能高度重叠，全文核查后必要时缩小或停止此idea。: EXT08 and the conference data-contract paper may overlap substantially; after checking the full text, narrow or stop this idea if needed.

CSWIM2022-P007.title: Digital Content Production and Internet Data Sponsorship: A Game-Theoretic Model
CSWIM2022-P007.abstract: Develops a data-sponsorship game between a content platform and an ISP and compares equilibria, quality investment, and profits; this is theoretical analysis, not empirical causal identification.

model_fields.research_design: Theoretical analysis; builds a multistage game and uses backward induction to derive the subgame-perfect Nash equilibrium.
model_fields.identification: Not applicable; no empirical causal identification.
model_fields.estimator: Analytical equilibrium solutions and parameter-condition comparisons. The paper presents equilibria for three network-management subgames and derives propositions based on content-production efficiency, advertising revenue rate, and other conditions.
model_fields.measurement_tool: Not applicable; model variables are theoretical constructs and decision quantities.
model_fields.analytical_model: A Hotelling horizontal-differentiation framework with two content providers, a monopolistic ISP, and a unit mass of consumers. The ISP chooses whether to allow data sponsorship and the per-packet price; content providers choose content quality and sponsorship quantity; consumers choose content based on utility. Content costs are quadratic, and the market is fully covered.

explicit_theory_and_lens.label: Hotelling competition framework.
explicit_theory_and_lens.role: The paper explicitly uses this theory model for consumer location, differentiated content, and market boundaries.
explicit_theory_and_lens.quote: draws on a Hotelling competition framework

decision_variables: Whether an ISP permits sponsorship and the data-plan price p.
Content quality of CP A and CP B: VA, VB.
Sponsored quantities sA and sB when approved.
outcomes: Profit and demand/market share for two content providers.
variables_and_tests.test_status: Not an empirical study: all propositions are derived from analytical equilibria. The paper presents equilibria for three content-provider management subgames and derives propositions under conditions involving content-production efficiency, advertising revenue rates, and other parameters. It states that data sponsorship may intensify competition and harm an unsponsored content provider when production efficiency is low; with higher efficiency, it may soften content-production competition and benefit both providers, while also changing ISP profit and optimal licensing decisions.

CSWIM2022-P023.abstract: Uses staggered adoption of a departmental target-disclosure system to analyze employee service allocation; the authors report DID results, while assumptions such as parallel trends require separate review.

model_fields.research_design: Quasi-experiment/difference-in-differences. The organization added a new-customer development goal to its IT system, but departments adopted it at different times. Departments adopting before 2019-10-01 are defined as the treatment group; later adopters are the control group. The observation unit is employee-month.
model_fields.identification: The authors use staggered adoption of IT-enabled goal disclosure (ITGD) to construct a difference-in-differences design, with employee and year-month fixed effects and employee-clustered standard errors. They state that α11 estimates the causal effect of ITGD. The assigned page segment does not show an event-study or parallel-trends plot, so the identification claim is recorded without independently certifying the assumption.
model_fields.estimator: Employee and year-month two-way fixed-effects DID; lagged outcome, controls, and triple interactions with tenure, customer diversity/relative service cost, and high income; robustness is reported for a propensity-score-matched sample.
model_fields.measurement_tool: Employee–customer-tier service records. The outcome is the employee’s service volume for customer tier j in month t; tiers 0–2 are treated as new/lower-tier customers and tiers 6–7 as more mature/higher-tier customers. Tenure is measured in months. Customer_diversity is measured as the entropy of service counts across tiers. High income indicates whether the employee’s historical average income exceeds the department average.
model_fields.analytical_model: Empirical panel model; not a formal theoretical model.

CSWIM2022-P071.title: The Effect of Reward Sequences on User Engagement: Evidence from a Large-scale Field Experiment
CSWIM2022-P071.abstract: Reward amounts are randomly assigned to study participation and retention. Conditional comparisons after reward-sequence formation involve behavioral selection and do not automatically equal the randomized average effect of the sequence.

model_fields.research_design: A mobile-app field experiment conducted with a Chinese telecom operator and lasting 10 days. On odd-numbered experiment days, users were randomly assigned 8, 58, or 108 points; on even-numbered days, everyone received 58 points. The analyses examine the probability of forming flat, increasing, decreasing, and volatile sequences; retention on Day 4 after sequence formation; and retention on Day 5 after an interrupted trend.
model_fields.identification: Reward amounts were randomized on odd-numbered experiment days. The analysis sample is limited to users who checked in on the first odd-numbered day and began checking in early enough. Comparisons of sequence formation and conditional retention are made after subsequent behavior, so differences across all conditions should not automatically be interpreted as unconditional average treatment effects under random assignment.
model_fields.estimator: Compares sequence-formation rates and retention proportions; the authors report regressions with time fixed effects and confidence intervals in figures.
model_fields.measurement_tool: System-recorded daily check-ins, rewards, and app-retention behavior; points are exchanged for RMB at approximately 100:1.
model_fields.analytical_model: No formal game-theoretic or analytical model; primarily a behavioral test of how randomized reward sequences affect users' subsequent retention.

dependent_variables: Formation rate for a three-day reward sequence.

variables_and_tests.test_status: More than 28,000 people enrolled, and 15,816 met the final analysis criteria. The increasing sequence had the lowest formation rate (3.5%; flat 5.7%, decreasing 5.2%, volatile 5.0%). On Day 4, retention under flat and increasing sequences exceeded that under decreasing and volatile sequences; the difference between flat and increasing sequences was not significant. Retention on Day 5 fell significantly after an increasing trend was interrupted. The authors therefore recommend a flat reward sequence.

CSWIM2023-P008.title: Understanding the Dynamics of Users’ Knowledge Contribution in Online Mental Communities: A Hidden Markov Model
CSWIM2023-P008.abstract: Fits a three-state HMM to weekly panels of online mental-health-community users to study transitions in knowledge-contribution states; associations between feedback and transitions are not causal effects.

model_fields.research_design: A user-week panel of 812 persistent participants in Yixinli, an online mental-health community, covering 2022-08-08 to 2023-01-01 (20 weeks). An HMM identifies latent states of contribution behavior, and the study examines factors associated with state transitions.
model_fields.identification: Models latent states/transitions in observational data; this is not randomized or quasi-experimental causal identification.
model_fields.estimator: A three-state hidden Markov model estimated with Bayesian methods; the three-state specification was selected based on BIC and model fit/predictive performance. Separate-sample HMMs and a state-transition model with covariates are also used to analyze feedback source, professional identity, and activity.
model_fields.measurement_tool: Contribution quantity: weekly number of answers. Quality proxies: average answer length and average votes per week. All three continuous measures are dichotomized at their medians. State-transition covariates include lagged questioner feedback, mental-health professional status, and platform activity.
model_fields.analytical_model: A discrete latent state S_it generates observed contribution outcomes O_it; transition probabilities may depend on prior-period feedback and user characteristics.

explicit_theory_and_lens.label: Social Motivation Theory.
explicit_theory_and_lens.role: Explicitly used to map latent motivational states to observable quantity/quality of knowledge contributions.

observed_outcomes: Average number of characters per answer.
transition_covariates: Whether questioner feedback was received in the prior week.
Whether participants are professional mental-health providers.
variables_and_tests.test_status: Three latent states—low, medium, and high—were identified. Overall initial-state probabilities were approximately (.7936, .0550, .1514). Associations between feedback source, user type, activity, and state transitions varied by state; for example, questioner feedback was associated with a higher probability/estimated association of low-state users moving to a higher state. The observational state model does not establish a causal effect of feedback. The authors note limits in proxy-scale validity and control-variable coverage.

CSWIM2023-P032.title: How Information Explicitness and Presentation Timing Affect Learning Process and Outcome: Evidence from A Field Experiment
CSWIM2023-P032.abstract: Classroom-randomized experiment comparing the clarity and timing of learning prompts; evaluates learning using exam scores and process logs. Some hypotheses were not supported.

model_fields.research_design: A five-week, large-scale randomized field experiment on a supplementary platform for compulsory English courses at multiple Chinese middle schools. The design has a 2 (high/low information explicitness) × 2 (during/after the task) treatment, plus a no-prompt control group. Students are randomized within classes; 937 participants complete system use and an exam.
model_fields.identification: Individual random assignment within classes supports experimental causal comparisons; school/class scope, implementation, and attrition details are recorded as stated in the page excerpts.
model_fields.estimator: ExamScore is analyzed using Poisson regression. The study reports effects of prompt clarity and timing, their interaction, and heterogeneity by prior knowledge. Mechanisms are examined using mouse trajectories, pop-up reading time, backward scrolling, and perceived learning efficiency, with t-tests/group comparisons.
model_fields.measurement_tool: English reading-comprehension exam scores; platform-recorded learning processes; mouse x/y coordinates, page-scroll positions, and timestamps; perceived efficiency from a questionnaire.
model_fields.analytical_model: Theoretical hypotheses explain the effects of prompt timing/clarity through proactive generation and reflection; there is no formalized game-theoretic or optimization model.

explicit_theory_and_lens.label: Active Learning Theory / the Active–Constructive–Interactive framework.
explicit_theory_and_lens.role: Explicitly distinguishes generation during a task from reflection after the task as the study’s foundation.

independent_variables: Timing of presentation (during vs. after the task).
mechanism_measures: Generation: popup reading duration and number of return scrolls through an article.
Reflection: post-task pop-up reading time and perceived learning efficiency.
variables_and_tests.test_status: During the task, low clarity improves performance relative to high clarity, supporting H1a; after the task, the overall difference between high and low clarity is not significant, so H1b is unsupported. Learners with strong prior knowledge benefit from low clarity during the task and high clarity after it; the authors report support for H2a/H2b. Low clarity during the task increases generative behavior. High clarity after the task increases pop-up reading time but does not significantly improve overall perceived efficiency.

CSWIM2026-P002.title: Distraction or Immersion? Investigating the Effect of Internet Memes on User Knowledge Acquisition Behavior in Online Reading
CSWIM2026-P002.abstract: The study examines memes in health articles and reading completion, using DML-IV and OCR, CLIP, and LLMs for measurement; instrument diagnostics do not establish the exclusion restriction.

model_fields.research_design: Observational data cover all original articles posted from 2021-01 through 2023-12 by an official WeChat health-communication account (N=2,876 articles; more than 18 million followers). The authors use DML-IV to study meme count and reading completion, and examine content relevance/humor and heterogeneity by article length/topic.
model_fields.identification: The authors claim causal identification using DML-IV. The instruments are the account's total meme posts on the preceding day and the number of Sina Weibo hot-search topics on the preceding day. They report KP LM χ²(2)=123.10, p<.001, Wald F=69.10, and Hansen J p=.586. The authors argue for the exclusion restriction; the coding does not treat these diagnostics as independent proof of that restriction.
model_fields.estimator: Double/debiased machine learning with instruments; Elastic Net nuisance functions and cross-fitting; models for log(meme count) and its squared term; heterogeneity examined through subsamples, interactions, and group comparisons.
model_fields.measurement_tool: DV completion rate = the proportion of readers who opened an article and finished reading it; four-stage meme detection (OCR, CLIP template matching, hard-negative filtering, and domain-term filtering), with recall of 82.1% on manual checks of 300 randomly sampled images; relevance measured by Sentence-BERT semantic similarity; humor rated by Qwen-VL-plus on a 0–10 scale; text controls include 25 LIWC dimensions.
model_fields.analytical_model: Nonlinear causal regression/DML-IV; the main dose variable is log_meme_count and its squared term.

explicit_theory_and_lens.label: Cognitive Load Theory.
explicit_theory_and_lens.role: Explains that too few memes may disrupt reading, while topic-relevant memes may reduce extraneous cognitive load.
explicit_theory_and_lens.quote: we draw on Cognitive Load Theory

explicit_theory_and_lens.label: Cognitive Absorption.
explicit_theory_and_lens.role: Complements cognitive load to explain immersion and continued reading associated with high meme integration and humor.

variables_and_tests.independent_variable: Log and squared terms for the number of memes in an article; extended variables are meme–context relevance and humor.
moderators_and_controls: LIWC features, number of images, word count, month, holidays, weekends, and posting time.
variables_and_tests.test_status: Both DML and DML-IV report a negative linear term and a positive quadratic term, which the authors characterize as U-shaped; in DML-IV, the linear coefficient is −.6241 and the squared-term coefficient is .7969, with a turning point at about 1.5 memes. Relevance attenuates the U shape. The interaction between humor and meme count is not significant, but in a subsample with at least one meme, humor has a coefficient of .1690 for completion rate (p<.1). The U shape is more pronounced for long articles and infectious-disease content.

CSWIM2026-P003.title: Modeling Motivation-Driven Behavior on Digital Content Platforms: A Context-Aware Gated Dual-Interest Model
CSWIM2026-P003.abstract: Predicts news rankings using dual-interest pathways and contextual gating, with baseline and ablation comparisons on MIND; the gate is a motivational proxy, not a direct psychological measure.

model_fields.research_design: A noncausal predictive/ranking-model design; compared with baselines such as TiSASRec, LSTUR, and CAUM on MIND news-consumption data, with ablations of the two pathways and temporal gate.
model_fields.identification: No causal identification; experiments aim to rank predictions and explain behavioral patterns.
model_fields.estimator: Two interest pathways share a semantic representation of content: a ritualistic-interest path conditioned on contextual prompts, and an instrumental-interest path that attends to recent user interactions and time decay. A temporal-context gate weights the two paths to form an interest representation. The model is evaluated using NDCG@5/10 and HR@5/10, with ablation analyses.
model_fields.measurement_tool: MIND users’ news clicks, content text, and timestamps. The analysis first retains users with at least three historical clicks; context is represented by discrete indicators such as time of day and day of week. Latent motives are not observed directly; gating values are operational signals inferred from behavioral and contextual inputs.
model_fields.analytical_model: Context-Aware Gated Dual-Interest Model; page 21 gives the two-path softmax representation, gate g_t, and combined interest representation.

explicit_theory_and_lens.label: Instrumental versus ritualized consumption motivation.
explicit_theory_and_lens.role: Explicitly used as a basis for distinguishing behavior and defining model constructs; platform records cannot directly observe actual motives.

variables_and_tests.inputs_and_prediction: User history clicks/content semantics and temporal context → user interest ranking of candidate news; noncausal predictors/outcome.
variables_and_tests.test_status: Visual cross-check results: the full model achieves NDCG@5=.3867, HR@5=.5600, NDCG@10=.4557, and HR@10=.7735; its NDCG@5 is 1.5999% higher than TiSASRec. Removing the instrumental-interest path produces the largest decline (NDCG@5 −17.6387%); removing the gate yields −8.7653%. These are ranking metrics, not causal effects.

I01.title: Why does more feedback fail to improve collaboration quality?
I01.summary: Separates feedback volume from feedback representativeness and tests selection bias caused by verification costs.
paper_titles: Is Fine-tuning Leveraging User Feedback truly beneficial?
I01.research_question: Does voluntary feedback omit difficult errors, thereby harming AI collaboration performance in the next round?
I01.mechanism: Task difficulty → verification cost → feedback entering the sample → update quality.
I01.design: Compares voluntary feedback with random audit under an equal budget; freezes initial outputs, the task pool, and the update algorithm, and evaluates on independent holdout tasks.
I01.falsification: The proposed mechanism is unsupported if feedback representativeness does not change, or if representativeness improves but performance on holdout tasks does not.
I01.nearest_neighbor: EXT01: delegation dynamics; EXT10: adaptive prompting; EXT09: disclosure expectations. First check whether the conference full texts already contain the same choice mechanism.
I01.limitations: Requires authorization for the task and repeatable model updates; without platform training access, use a controlled research environment.

I02.title: After an explanation, can an erroneous decision actually be corrected?
I02.summary: Distinguishes transparent explanations from appeal channels that can actually correct misjudgments.
paper_titles: Effects of Autonomous Algorithmic Moderation on User Content Contribution
I02.research_question: How do explanations and actionable appeals, separately, affect correction of erroneous judgments and subsequent compliant participation?
I02.mechanism: Actionable correction → actual recovery and perceived control → compliant participation.
I02.design: A 2 × 2 randomized experiment on explainability × actionable appeal fixes the initial error and records actual recovery; compares the treatment with a time-matched information control.
I02.falsification: If only satisfaction improves while errors persist and compliance contributions do not change, or an equal-time reassurance procedure produces the same change, that would not support the correction mechanism.
I02.nearest_neighbor: The three entries overlap with the full texts EXT14 (Reddit governance), EXT07 (institutional black boxes), and EXT03 (FAIR). The innovation-versus-replication positioning should be decided only after comparing the full papers.
I02.limitations: Controlled-task results do not directly generalize to all public algorithm-governance contexts.

I03.title: Does a data contract specify rights, and does the backend actually honor them?
I03.summary: Separates contract disclosure from enforceable data rights and observes task acceptance, quality, and avoidance behavior.
paper_titles: Navigating Task Performance in the Gig Economy: The Role of Data Usage Contract Governance
I03.research_question: Do disclosure commitments and enforceable data rights affect gig-worker behavior through different pathways?
I03.mechanism: Enforceable rights → actual control and risk judgments → task choice and effort.
I03.design: Manipulate disclosure and backend execution while holding pay, monitoring intensity, and task difficulty constant; record actual rights use and behavior.
I03.falsification: If only self-reported trust changes while actual use and behavior do not, the evidence does not support an actionable rights mechanism.
I03.nearest_neighbor: EXT08: monitoring/transparency/control; EXT16: control-resistance scale; EXT17: algorithmic procedural fairness; EXT05: wage targets and EXT15: labor reallocation boundaries.
I03.limitations: EXT08 and the conference data-contract paper may overlap substantially; after checking the full text, narrow or stop this idea if needed.

EXT01.title: Find the Good. Seek the Unity: A Hidden Markov Model of Human-AI Delegation Dynamics
EXT01.summary: A longitudinal study of delegation by 875 store managers examines manager–AI collaboration. Managers' evaluations of AI performance, perceptions of its capabilities, and willingness to delegate form feedback loops; delegation intentions may diverge over time.

EXT02.title: Guardrails for Human-AI Ecologies: Norm-Based Coordination and Design for Predictability
EXT02.summary: A design theory is proposed for coordination among multiple human and AI agents. Existing norms and predictive models jointly shape action; prediction errors prompt agents to adjust norms in unanticipated situations, while design principles support monitoring and intervention.

EXT03.title: FAIR: A Design Theory for Artificial Intelligence Fairness
EXT03.summary: AI fairness is framed as a persistent tension arising from interactions among organizational, technical, and governance choices. FAIR design theory proposes an adaptive cycle for identifying and addressing tensions, along with system-level and portfolio-level governance mechanisms.

EXT04.title: Does Sharing Make My Data More Insecure? An Empirical Study on Health Information Exchange and Data Breaches
EXT04.summary: The study examines changes in data-breach risk after hospitals join a health information exchange. It uses governance and coordination to explain how interorganizational sharing may simultaneously create risks and security practices, and compares settings by IT maturity and security-law context.

EXT05.title: Surge Pricing and Short-Term Wage Elasticity of Labor Supply in Real-Time Ridesharing Markets
EXT05.summary: Uses Chinese ride-hailing platform data and an exogenous shock created by driving restrictions to identify short-run wage elasticity. Results are consistent with a mechanism in which drivers decide when to stop based on daily income targets; taxi drivers are also compared.

EXT06.title: The Voice of Commerce: How Smart Speakers Reshape Digital Content Consumption and Preferences
EXT06.summary: Studies the relationship between smart-speaker adoption and digital-content search, purchase, and consumption. Household panels, remote-control usage, and survey evidence distinguish increased purchasing from reduced completed consumption, and the study discusses a search-cost mechanism.

EXT07.title: When Justice is Blind to Algorithms: Multilayered Blackboxing of Algorithmic Decision-Making in the Public Sector
EXT07.summary: A case involving algorithmic decision-making in public-school allocation illustrates how organizational avoidance and institutional responses beyond the technology can obscure the problem, creating a social and institutional black box that affects correction and legal remedies.

EXT08.title: The Hidden Costs and Benefits of Monitoring in the Gig Economy
EXT08.summary: Online experiments on AMT and Prolific compare how monitoring intensity, transparency, and information control affect willingness to accept work. Privacy concerns and perceived payment protection form distinct pathways, and transparency and control measures have boundaries in their applicability.

EXT09.title: The Indirect Disclosure Effect: How Disclosing Generative AI Use Impacts Human Creative Collaboration with AI
EXT09.summary: Two nested mixed-method experiments are proposed to study how disclosing GenAI use changes creators' collaboration. Creators may fear that audiences will not recognize their creative agency, reducing participation; thus, disclosure policy may affect the work before audiences see the label.

EXT10.title: Prompt Adaptation as a Dynamic Complement in Generative AI Systems
EXT10.summary: Two preregistered tasks with 3,750 participants examine the complementarity of model upgrades and prompt adaptation. Adaptation gains differ between fixed evaluation tasks and open-ended creative tasks; automatic prompt rewriting also depends on goal alignment.

EXT11.title: Contextual Targeting in mHealth Apps: Harnessing Weather Information and Message Framing to Increase Physical Activity
EXT11.summary: A field experiment and follow-up experiments compare how gain- versus loss-framed information in weather contexts affects completion of exercise goals, and examine heterogeneity by repeated intervention and low-activity/low-income areas.

EXT12.title: Addressing Online Users’ Suspicion of Sponsored Search Results: Effects of Informational Cues
EXT12.summary: Three experiments test how information cues such as reviews and ratings can reduce users’ suspicion of mismatched sponsored search results. The study distinguishes decision uncertainty, perceived platform malice, and result processing, and analyzes when cues are internalized.

EXT13.title: Too Tired and in Too Good of a Mood to Worry About Privacy: Explaining the Privacy Paradox Through the Lens of Effort Level in Information Processing
EXT13.summary: Three experiments show that cognitive-resource depletion, positive affect, and their joint effect weaken the relationship between privacy concerns and actual disclosure behavior. The privacy paradox is context-dependent and cannot be read as evidence that individuals do not care about privacy.

EXT14.title: Platform Governance with Algorithm-Based Content Moderation: An Empirical Study on Reddit
EXT14.summary: An econometric analysis of moderation bots across 156 Reddit communities examines effects on volunteer moderators, distinguishes rule enforcement from community cultivation, and discusses scale heterogeneity and volunteer retention.

EXT15.title: Skill-Biased Technical Change, Again? Online Gig Platforms and Local Employment
EXT15.summary: Studies employment reallocation across local skill levels following a platform's entry into cities; city/occupation-level treatment is not an individual contract intervention.

EXT16.title: Towards a Measurement Instrument for Assessing Resistance to Algorithmic Control: Conceptualization and Content Validity
EXT16.summary: Expert interviews and worker ratings establish content validity for resistance to algorithmic control; this is not a causal effect of contract-rights interventions.

EXT17.title: Fair Dealings with Algorithms? Analyzing the Perceived Procedural Fairness of Managerial Algorithms and their Impacts on Gig-Workers
EXT17.summary: Uses driver surveys to study algorithmic procedural fairness, satisfaction, and perceived organizational support; these should be distinguished from actual back-end rights and objective behavior.
